card.name: Words signaling huge amounts or repetition
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases of vast quantity or repetition, such as millions of, hill after hill, billions upon billions, and plural herds. It fires on the word that continues the phrase, in general web prose.

modes.label: Millions of ...
modes.description: The unit or repeated number word in a phrase like millions of or millions and millions.
modes.example: taking millions and<< millions>> of years to progress

modes.label: Repetition or long spans
modes.description: Words like after, upon, or long that build a repeated or extended expanse.
modes.example: But outside, hill<< after>> hill is chock-a-bloc with

modes.label: Collective plural
modes.description: The plural ending of a group noun meaning a large number of animals.
modes.example: it was the home of massive her<<ds>> of cattle and horses

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up in phrases that stress very large numbers or endless repetition, like millions of or hill after hill.
